Bench Press (BB): Set the upper back tightly, plant the feet, lower the bar under control to the lower chest, keep the forearms stacked, then press without losing shoulder-blade position.
Incline Press (DB): Use a moderate incline. Keep the shoulder blades back and down, lower the dumbbells into a deep comfortable pec stretch, then press while keeping tension on the upper chest.
Romanian Deadlift (BB): Keep a soft knee bend, push the hips back, keep the bar close, and hinge until the hamstrings are strongly loaded with a stable spine. Stand by driving the hips forward.
Assisted Pull-Up: Use enough assistance for strict reps. Start long, pull the elbows toward the ribs, bring the chest toward the bar, and avoid swinging.
Weighted Pull-Up: Keep the added load stable, pull from a controlled hang until the chin clears the bar, then lower under control without kipping.
Hammer Squat Press: Brace into the machine, keep the whole foot planted and knees tracking naturally, descend to your deepest controlled pain-free position, then drive up.
Leg Press: Keep the hips supported, lower under control while the knees track naturally, stop before the pelvis rolls, then press without violent lockout.
Seated Leg Curl: Keep the hips pinned down, curl through the hamstrings, squeeze briefly, and control the return into the lengthened position.
Reverse Pec Deck: Keep the chest supported and shoulders down. Sweep the arms back with the rear delts, pause, then return under control.
Biceps Curl (DB): Keep the upper arms controlled, curl without throwing the shoulders forward, squeeze, then lower into a full comfortable length.
Triceps Pressdown: Keep the upper arms near the torso, extend at the elbows, squeeze the triceps, and control the return.
Farmer Carry (DB): Stand tall, brace hard, keep the shoulders organized, and walk with controlled steps without leaning or letting the dumbbells swing.
